author: JustHereForTheCats
title: Functionality recently changed
content:
I have had this app for years. This particular HP printer is the longest lasting HP product over ever had lol.  
At some point within the last couple of months, I can no longer fully utilize the app when I am go from outside of the app and select “print with HP app” (iOS).  

If I want to print a shipping label or a document, I can normally select it, scroll down to the HP app option, and it’ll load up the app. I could choose how many copies or if it’s B&W/Color. No longer. It’s just a white tab with the arrows.  

I have tried uninstalling the app and reinstalling. I have tried restarting my phone. I have tried restarting the printer. I can’t get those to come back. 
The interface is entirely different, but those features appear to work when going through the app to select things. I will say, it was nice to NOT have to save items to my iPhone just so I can go through the app to find them. Sometimes you get a doc in email and want to print straight from there. 

While this is a small issue, it’s also an issue that only recently popped up after using it for years, plus, I can’t seem to contact them about it without making an HP account.
